# MAGNM — Creative Studio

> Translating bold vision into lasting impact. Motion-driven websites, AI products, branding systems, and 3D digital flagships built for clarity, scale, and impact.

## About MAGNM
MAGNM is an experimental creative studio and digital engineering firm based in Indore, India. We bridge the gap between aesthetic precision and robust software engineering, creating digital flagships that feel both intuitive and impactful.

- **Website**: https://magnm.com
- **Inquiries & Contact**: hello@magnm.com
- **Location**: Indore, Madhya Pradesh, India
- **Founders & Creators**: Pranav Dubey & Adarsh Pathade

## Core Capabilities
- **Motion-Driven Web Experiences**: Timeline-choreographed interactions, micro-interactions, and fluid transitions.
- **3D & WebGL Engineering**: Real-time Three.js shaders, 3D kinetic elements, and WebGL carousel engines.
- **Brand Identity Systems**: Monochromatic visual systems, typography hierarchy, and strategic brand positioning.
- **AI Products & Interfaces**: Interface design and product architecture for artificial intelligence applications.
- **Creative Web Development**: Full-stack Next.js, React, Tailwind CSS, and Web Audio API integration.

## Philosophy
- **Exact Visual Fidelity**: Treating design as precision engineering with zero generic compromises.
- **Intentional Motion**: Smooth, physics-guided transitions without unnecessary decorative noise.
- **High Performance**: 60fps GPU-accelerated rendering, minimal DOM complexity, and fast load times.
